description: A device introduces itself by signing "NereusSDR introduce v1\n" || station id (26 ASCII bytes) || nonce, where nonce is the 32 raw bytes the introducing connection's hello nonce decodes to. The rendezvous forwards the signature untouched; the station verifies it with the key of the paired device whose id is device (the base64url SHA-256 of its SPKI DER, link section 3.5).

device.fixed: A fixed public key for these vectors. The key was generated only to produce them and is used by nothing else (no Core, device or server); a runner only verifies with it.

cases.name: nonceAsText
cases.why: signed over the nonce's base64url text instead of its 32 bytes

cases.name: flippedBit
cases.why: the first bit of r flipped

cases.name: highS
cases.why: s replaced by n - s (a high-s signature): valid, since r and s are both from 1 to n - 1 and verifiers such as OpenSSL and CryptoKit accept it

cases.name: sIsN
cases.why: s equals the group order n

cases.name: rIsN
cases.why: r equals the group order n
